newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products tread softly in sideways market.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products tread softly in sideways market.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady amid slow activity on Tuesday, traders said.
Fuel oil markets were largely stable with talk persisting of Russian cracked cargoes arriving to push barges lower in Rotterdam, where values were a touch weaker. August barges traded at $90 a tonne.
Gas oil was unchanged with August IPE at $167.00 a tonne. Spreads were stable. Prompt heating oil barges were August IPE +$0.25/$0.75 with second half August around August IPE +$0.75/$1.25.
Gasoline remains very tight for prompt material.
Eurograde barges hovered around $203.00 fob, but further into August levels were down to $200.
